=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/node-hardhat-solidity/tests/20_rpc_probe.sh.j2:14-31 | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The RPC probe script never sources `validate.env`, so it uses host-shell defaults for `APP_SERVICE` and `RPC_URL` and can override the manifest-provided compose/container values with incorrect ones.
  WHY: All three reviewers identified that the script reads `APP_SERVICE`/`RPC_URL` from defaults, then passes them into `docker compose exec`, which can target the wrong service and RPC endpoint at runtime.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/node-hardhat-solidity/tests/20_rpc_probe.sh.j2:14-16, 28-30 | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The RPC probe script does not source `validate.env`, so `APP_SERVICE` and `RPC_URL` fall back to host-shell defaults and can override manifest-provided values.
  WHY: When `env_overrides` sets custom values, the script passes the host defaults into `docker compose exec`, which can make the probe use the wrong service or RPC endpoint.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/node-hardhat-solidity/tests/20_rpc_probe.sh.j2:14-16, 28-30 | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The RPC probe script never sources `validate.env`, so manifest overrides for `APP_SERVICE` and `RPC_URL` are ignored and the script passes incorrect defaults into the container.
  WHY: If a manifest sets custom `env_overrides`, the probe uses `APP_SERVICE=app` and `RPC_URL=http://anvil:8545` instead of the rendered values, causing validation failures or false negatives.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/node-hardhat-solidity/tests/20_rpc_probe.sh.j2:14-16 and 28-31 | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The RPC probe script sets default values for `APP_SERVICE` and `RPC_URL` from the host shell environment but never sources `validate.env` to pick up manifest overrides.
  WHY: The compose template correctly bakes the overrides into the container, but `docker compose exec -e RPC_URL="http://anvil:8545"` can override the correct manifest value with the wrong default.
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/node-hardhat-solidity/tests/20_rpc_probe.sh.j2:30 | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The RPC probe uses `"${APP_SERVICE}"` for the docker compose exec service name without sourcing `validate.env`.
  WHY: If a manifest sets `APP_SERVICE: "custom-app"`, the script will run `docker compose exec -T "app"` instead of targeting the manifest-provided service.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
